leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Construct an AbortController instance to manage cancellation of fetch requests.
Access the AbortController's signal property to pass cancellation capability to fetch calls.
Implement the AbortController within a useEffect hook to handle cleanup operations.
Execute the abort() method on the AbortController to cancel ongoing fetch requests.
Define a cleanup function within useEffect to return abort logic when the component unmounts or dependencies change.
Apply conditional logic to check if a fetch request should be aborted based on component lifecycle.
Utilize TypeScript typing to properly type the AbortController and its signal property.
Handle asynchronous fetch operations with proper error handling for aborted requests.
Control component side effects by integrating AbortController with useEffect's dependency array.
Return the cleanup function from useEffect to ensure proper resource management.
Modify existing fetch calls to incorporate AbortController for cancellation support.
Store the AbortController instance in a variable to maintain reference for cleanup operations.
